DIRECTION A — FULL PAGE, COPY OPTIMISED

Sixteen sections: hero with the live scan · data-source band · "run it on your domain" scanner · the problem · why AI SEO matters now · AI SEO vs traditional SEO · the 90-day sprint · the Evidence Engine · AI visibility (dark) · how to choose an AI SEO service · Growth Credits · pricing · guarantee + founding cohort · FAQ · closing CTA · footer.

Copy rewritten against NeuronWriter for "ai seo services" and scored 81/100 — above the best page currently ranking on that term. Three sections are new: why AI SEO matters now, the SEO-vs-GEO comparison, and the five-question buyer's guide.

Static mockup — nothing is clickable. The FAQ shows every answer open so the copy reads at a glance. One lever above the artboard changes the accent colour across the whole page.

Direction A at phone width — the full page, not one screen.

Headline drops to 34px, every CTA is a full-width 54px target, the three-up grids stack, and the SEO-vs-GEO panels and buyer's guide reflow to a single column.

8,720px against the desktop's 10,639 — the copy is the same, it just costs less height at 390 wide.

The three directions not chosen, kept for reference.

B · Editorial ledger — serif masthead, scan as a ruled table.
C · Sprint board — all three months above the fold.
D · Price-forward — $97 at 152px, one button.

None of these is being carried forward; delete the page whenever you want it gone.
